item.title: Set up for a birthday at the hall
item.context_text: You are helping with a birthday party. The hall has chairs but the kitchen is locked.
item.objective_text: Tell helpers what to bring and set up before the guests arrive.
success_conditions: Tell helpers what to bring and set up before the guests arrive.

children.title: Read the hall note
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: You can enter at two. The party begins at three. There are tables and chairs. The kitchen is closed today. Leave the fire door clear.

questions.explanation: The hall opens one hour before the party.

children.title: Hear a helper’s message
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I have the cake and candles. I can bring some balloons too, but I do not have paper plates. The shop next to the bus stop sells them.

questions.prompt: What is this helper bringing for sure?
questions.explanation: The helper says they have the cake and candles.

options: At the shop by the bus stop
questions.explanation: The helper names the shop by the bus stop.

children.title: Ask another helper for two things
children.prompt_text: Pat is passing the shop before the party.
children.instructions: Ask Pat to buy plates and arrive before the guests. Give a time.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Hi Pat, can you buy some paper plates at the shop by the bus stop? Please come at half past two so we can put them on the tables.

children.title: Write a message for the helpers
children.prompt_text: Send the whole group a short plan so people do not bring extra chairs or block a door.
children.instructions: Include the helper arrival time, the kitchen rule and which door must stay clear. Add one setup job.
children.goal: Tell helpers what to bring and set up before the guests arrive.
children.model_answer: Please come at half past two to set up the hall. It has tables and chairs. Put the plates and cake on the long table. The kitchen is closed today. Leave the fire door clear. The party begins at three.

points.label: Keep the exit clear
any: do not block the fire door
